correctness.rationale: The barycentric-coordinate fixed-orbit lemma identifies |K|^H with the complex of H-orbits whose unions are faces. For the cube this is precisely the coset Hamming diameter criterion. Weight-one H has cosets with graph adjacency Q_{n-1} at r=2 and isolated cosets at r=1. Weight-two H has A_y,B_y bipartite Cayley generators (1,0),(1,e_j) forming an F2 basis, yielding Q_{n-1}. Every rank-two subspace of nonzero weights <=2 is either a coordinate square or a 3-coordinate even-parity plane; distinct orbits cannot combine, giving 2^(n-2) isolated barycenters. Such planes admit no admissible rank-three extension. Vertex/edge counts give cube cycle rank 1+(n-3)2^(n-2), and constant integer-threshold filtration gives the asserted persistence. Independent direct coset/compatibility enumeration for every rank<=3 H at n=3,4,5 found rank-one graph loci 6,10,15; rank-two point loci 4,10,20; no exceptions. No extrapolation from finite checks.
